title: Narration
empty: Enter a manuscript and press “Split” to render it chunk by chunk.

manuscript.title: Manuscript
manuscript.placeholder: Paste the text to read, or open a file (.txt / .md / .srt / .vtt).
manuscript.rulesHint: Sentences (split at full stops and line breaks) are grouped within this range. Chunks are kept under the {{seconds}}-second limit of one generation, and a paragraph (blank line) always ends a chunk.
manuscript.srtHint: Each subtitle becomes one chunk, generated to fit the subtitle's duration.
manuscript.rulesInvalid: The minimum must be at least 1, the maximum at least 20, and the minimum no larger than the maximum.
manuscript.resplitConfirm: Splitting again discards all rendered audio. Continue?

settings.title: Voice and settings
settings.voiceHintReference: This voice has reference audio (or a speaker embedding), so it stays the same across chunks.
settings.voiceHintNone: Without reference audio the voice may change from chunk to chunk. Choose a voice with reference audio, or use voice lock.
settings.voiceLockHint: The first chunk's audio becomes the reference audio for the chunks after it.
settings.caption: Caption (manner, emotion)
settings.pausesHint: Silence inserted when the chunks are joined. A chunk split mid-sentence gets half the sentence pause.
settings.unsaved: You have unsaved changes (saved automatically before rendering or joining).

chunks.title: Chunks
chunks.analyzerMissing: The reading analyzer is not installed yet, so lengths are estimated from characters (it is added at the next start).
chunks.readingsHint: Estimated readings are a guide; the model may pronounce words differently. Words replaced by the dictionary are highlighted.

warnings.cue_too_long: Subtitle {{index}} is longer than {{limit}} seconds and will be cut at {{limit}} seconds.
warnings.cue_overlap: Subtitle {{index}} overlaps the previous one; it is placed after the previous subtitle's audio.
warnings.chunk_too_long: Chunk {{index}} may exceed {{limit}} seconds. Shorten its text.

render.cancelled: Cancelled. “Render remaining chunks” continues where it stopped.

chunk.editHint: Changing the text discards this chunk's audio.
chunk.truncated: Reached the {{limit}}-second limit; the end may be cut off.

export.title: Join and export
export.incomplete: {{missing}} chunks are not rendered yet. Render them all to join.
export.perChunk: Also export one audio file per chunk
